objectives.text: Find Lady _lady_, held captive by the _monster_ in ___mondung_
Bring Lady _lady_ safely back to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: Lady _lady_ is home, and the order will not forget who brought her back.
Lady _lady_ had to find her own way home. So much for knightly valor.

objectives.text: Hunt down and slay the traitor =monster_ in ___mondun_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The traitor is dead, and the order's honor is answered.
The traitor =monster_ still lives, and the order's honor goes unanswered.

objectives.text: Stop the _soldier_ bent on destroying %reg. He holds ___mondung_ with his troops.
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The crazed _soldier_ is dead, and %reg is safe from his madness.
The _soldier_ still plots the ruin of %reg from ___mondung_.

objectives.text: Break the orc band in ___dungeon_, and be sure of its leader, =monster_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The orcs' leader is dead, and the glory of %reg is yours.
The orcs still befoul %reg from ___dungeon_.

objectives.text: Slay =monster_, warlord of the orc band raiding caravans from ___dungeon_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: By the old custom of arms, the orcs' plunder from the caravans belongs to the knight who broke them.

choices.text: Claim the spoils by right of the sword
Return them to the caravan masters

outcomes.text: The warlord is dead, and the caravans' plunder is yours by right of arms.
The warlord is dead, and the caravan masters have their goods back.
The orcs of ___dungeon_ still raid the caravans of %reg.

objectives.text: Slay the _monster_ with the bear claw brand in ___dungeon_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: The herders the giant robbed have scraped together a purse for you.

choices.text: Refuse it, and let them buy new cattle

outcomes.text: The giant is dead, and the herders paid what they could.
The giant is dead, and the herders kept their purse to buy new cattle. %reg will remember it.
The giant of ___dungeon_ still raids the farms of %reg.

objectives.text: Banish the spirit haunting ___dungeon_ before _nobleman_ begins to rebuild
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: _nobleman_ means to raise a fountain with your name carved upon it.

choices.text: Let it be a well for the common folk, with no name on it

outcomes.text: The ghost is laid, and a fountain will bear your name.
The ghost is laid, and the common folk have a well that bears no one's name.
The ghost still haunts ___dungeon_, and _nobleman_ cannot rebuild.

objectives.text: Burn the corpse of _nobleman_'s ancestor in ___dungeon_. Destroy it if it walks.
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: _nobleman_ offers you the grave goods of ___dungeon_ for your trouble.

outcomes.text: The old woman is ash, and her grave goods are yours by her heir's gift.
The old woman is ash, and she rests with all that was buried with her.
Whatever walks in ___dungeon_ walks there still.

objectives.text: Slay every Daedra loose in ___dungeon_. The Mages Guild will tell you when the last falls.
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: The order does not pay its own, but a rogue mage's lie has earned you gold this once.

choices.text: Refuse it, and send it to the Fighters Guild she cheated

outcomes.text: The Daedra are dead, and this once the order paid in gold.
The Daedra are dead. You fought for glory, as you swore, and the Fighters Guild has its fee.
The Daedra of ___dungeon_ were left for others to slay.

objectives.text: Slay the dragonling hatched in ___dungeon_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: _qgiver_ would have you tell the order you both stood before the dragon, as you agreed.

outcomes.text: The dragonling is dead, and you and _qgiver_ share the glory, as you agreed.
The dragonling is dead, and the order knows who truly slew it and who did not.
The dragonling of ___dungeon_ lives, and there is no glory for anyone.

objectives.text: Seek out the witch in ___dungeon1_ who knows where the artifact lies
Kidnap _child_ from _palace_ in __palace_ and bring her to _witch_
Find the artifact in ___dungeon2_

branches.text: A guard of _palace_ orders you to put _child_ down, or die.

choices.text: Keep hold of her and fight your way out

outcomes.text: You put _child_ down and she went home. The artifact is lost to you; your honor is not.
You gave _child_ to the witch, and the artifact is yours.
The artifact was never found.

objectives.text: Destroy the lich raising an army of undead in ___dungeon_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: The lich's books of necromancy: the Mages Guild would buy them, the temple would burn them.

choices.text: Sell them to the Mages Guild
Burn them, as the temple asks

outcomes.text: The lich is destroyed, and its books have gone to the Mages Guild's scholars.
The lich is destroyed, and its books are ash.
The lich of ___dungeon_ still gathers its army.

objectives.text: Destroy the lich raising an army of undead in ___dungeon_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_
Follow the dead seeker's clue to ___dungeon2_
Lay _wizard_'s great grandfather to rest in ___dungeon3_, with the lock of hair on you
Take the artifact from _mageguild_ in __mageguild_

branches.text: _wizard_ will lead you to a lost artifact the Mages Guild hid away, in return for a favor.

outcomes.text: The lich is dust, and the artifact the Mages Guild hid is yours.
The lich is dust. You turned the wizard's bargain down and left the Mages Guild's secret alone.
The lich is dust, and %reg is saved.
The order gave its charge to another knight.

objectives.text: Slay the traitor =monster_, slinking about in ___mondun_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The traitor is dead, and the order has begun to trust you.
The traitor =monster_ still lives, and the order still does not trust you.

objectives.text: Kill the _monster_ raiding the farms, in ___dungeon_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The _monster_ is dead, and _qgiver_ trusts you a little more.
The _monster_ still raids the farms, and _qgiver_ still does not trust you.

objectives.text: Slay =monster_, leader of the orc band in ___dungeon_
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The orcs' leader is dead, and the order begins to think you can be trusted.
The orc band still troubles the land around ___dungeon_.

objectives.text: Rid _house_ in __house_ of its infestation
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: _house_ is clean, and _qgiver_ may put in a good word for you.
The day ran out before _house_ was clean.
